name: INSAS
recent: Insas 于 2026 年 11 月 26 日召开第 64 届常年股东大会及特别股东大会，所有议案均获通过，包括向 Inari Amertron 出售最多 5.63% 股权的股东授权。公司于 11 月 19 日公布 2027 财年首季业绩，并宣布派发每股 3.5 仙中期股息。此外，公司于 11 月多次进行股份回购。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会上通过议案，授权 Insas 全资子公司出售最多 218,051,475 股 Inari Amertron 股份（约 5.63% 股权）。
公司宣布 2027 财年每股 3.5 仙的单层中期股息。
公司于 11 月多个交易日进行股份回购。
risks: 公司于 2026 年 11 月 19 日公布季度业绩时，对物业、厂房及设备进行注销。
首席执行官兼执行董事 Dato' Wong Gian Kui 及执行董事 Dato' Dr Tan Seng Chuan 在闭市期前申报持股意向。
earnings: 2026 财年（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 1.9057 亿令吉，净利润为 9947.5 万令吉，净利率 52.2%。营收环比增长 372.5%，净利润环比增长 285.6%；营收同比增长 199.3%，净利润同比增长 404.2%。

recent_en: Insas held its 64th AGM and EGM on 26 November 2026, where all resolutions were passed, including the shareholders' mandate to dispose of up to 5.63% equity interest in Inari Amertron. The company announced its 1Q FY2027 results on 19 November and declared an interim dividend of 3.5 sen per share. It also conducted multiple share buybacks in November.
notable_en: Shareholders at the EGM approved the mandate for Insas's wholly-owned subsidiaries to dispose of up to 218,051,475 Inari Amertron shares (approximately 5.63% equity interest).
The company declared a single-tier interim dividend of 3.5 sen per share for FY2027.
The company conducted share buybacks on multiple trading days in November.
risks_en: The company reported a write-off of property, plant and equipment when announcing its quarterly results on 19 November 2026.
CEO/Executive Director Dato' Wong Gian Kui and Executive Director Dato' Dr Tan Seng Chuan declared their intentions to deal in securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was MYR 190.57 million and net income was MYR 99.475 million, with a net margin of 52.2%. Revenue grew 372.5% QoQ and net income grew 285.6% QoQ; revenue grew 199.3% YoY and net income grew 404.2% YoY.
